subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline keys only, or by adding an OpenClaw-owned configurable send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies newline insertion through pi-tui, but the remaining configurable behavior would create a new public TUI config or CLI contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow TUI keybinding config or CLI surface with default and customized send/newline tests.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's built-in newline support as enough and close or narrow this issue if docs/help and configurability are intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior review context and the strongest current-history signal across the TUI docs/help/editor surfaces.
